question: Should the copied editor/suggestion.tsx behavior become a platejs/suggestion feature, and what should remain native authored capability or copied presentation?
method: best-api-review/history-v2; redesign-from-first-principles; Best API hard-cut and package gates; Plate/Plite ownership; bounded live-source comparison
trigger: User explicitly selects the copied suggestion component and asks whether to provide platejs/suggestion.
requirements: Support suggesting mode, visible change identification, review selection and decision outcomes without making applications own semantic invalidation or capability casts.
Preserve one canonical authored identity, accepted content, retained content, causal decisions, authenticated authorship and exact-view intent/projection.
Keep ordinary authorship/history, AI and format use possible without a human suggestion UI; keep Comments optional and presentation copyable.
Compare deleting, merging, inlining, extending authored, publishing a suggestion feature and restoring an independent suggestion engine before judging the package boundary.
Review this proposal only; preserve the broader prior behavior audit and avoid product implementation or downstream plan creation.
evidenceReuse: Read both prior suggestions records and their current decision. Re-read the copied suggestion owner, discussion and mode consumers, native authored facade/default descriptor, authored public outcomes, retained DOM markers, independent version-history and AI consumers, and entrypoint topology. Reused prior Google and performance observations only as historical constraints, without refreshing their proof. Live discussion code already reads details and surfaces blocked/stale outcomes, so those prior gap statements are not repeated as current failures.
summary: Pursue a Plate suggestion feature with reusable semantic review and React integration over the canonical authored owner. Remove copied cast/subscription/decoration protocols where their existing owner can own them. Keep themes, cards, toolbar layout, kit membership and comments composition copyable. Do not restore a second suggestion engine or rename all authored APIs to suggestion.
alternatives: Keep the full copied file: reject as the target. It makes consumers maintain semantic membership equality, commit invalidation, decoration lifetime and a capability cast along with visual customization.

Move the whole file to platejs/suggestion/react unchanged: reject. That would publish theme classes, a Comments dependency and mirrored first-thread policy while preserving all current subscription machinery.

Delete the suggestion feature and merge all behavior into authored: reject wholesale. Neutral authored history, format and AI jobs are independent of human review interaction. Repair missing neutral view/query/marker contracts at authored or React; keep product workflow in Plate.

Replace platejs/authored with a suggestion name or duplicate its accept/reject/read surface: reject. Authorship and selective accepted-history reversal are broader jobs; aliases do not remove coordination.
Restore the independent Suggestion mutation engine or create a second suggestion change store: reject. No current requirement justifies duplicate identity, retained content, decisions or persistence.

Publish a focused Plate suggestion feature: pursue. Reuse native authored facts/decisions, provide durable semantic interaction and React lifecycle, infer capability from plugin composition, and let copied UI style neutral output. Comments integration stays with existing composition. First compare native marker reuse and exact-view ownership before retaining any observer, mirrored state or scheduler.
proofLimits: Single-proposal source review, not a repeat of the 44-family behavior audit. No product edit, test replay, browser session, native-device proof, benchmark or package build. Source inspection supports ownership and existing call-path claims only. The selected runtime remains provisional pending exact-view lifetime, projection-only invalidation, comments independence, inferred public calls, package/peer closure and complete-operation scale proof. Existing tests were inspected only. Public exports are proposed; no new signature is certified.
